186	def receive(run_dir: Path, command: str, max_trials: int | None = None) -> bool:
187	    public_seal, public_ledger = seal_paths(run_dir)
188	    seal_commit = ensure_published((str(public_seal.relative_to(ROOT)), *SOURCE_FILES))
189	    seal_path = run_dir / "sender_seal.json"
190	    seal_hash = digest(seal_path.read_bytes())
191	    if seal_hash != public_seal.read_text(encoding="ascii").strip():
192	        raise ValueError("sender seal differs from published digest")
193	    if max_trials is not None and max_trials < 1:
194	        raise ValueError("max_trials must be positive")
195	    ledger_path, progress = run_dir / "ledger.json", run_dir / "receiver_progress.json"
196	    if ledger_path.exists():
197	        raise FileExistsError("receiver ledger already complete")
198	    registration, secret, seal = load(REGISTRATION), load(SECRET), load(seal_path)
199	    validate_registration(registration, secret)
200	    if seal["registration_sha256"] != digest(REGISTRATION.read_bytes()):
201	        raise ValueError("sender seal registration mismatch")
202	    state = load(progress) if progress.exists() else {
203	        "sender_seal_sha256": seal_hash, "receiver_command": command,
204	        "seal_commit": seal_commit, "rows": [],
205	    }
206	    if (state["sender_seal_sha256"], state["receiver_command"], state["seal_commit"]) != (
207	        seal_hash, command, seal_commit
208	    ):
209	        raise ValueError("receiver checkpoint differs from sender seal")
210	    rows = seal["sender_rows"]
211	    if [r["trial_id"] for r in state["rows"]] != [r["trial_id"] for r in rows[:len(state["rows"])]]:
212	        raise ValueError("receiver checkpoint trial order mismatch")
213	    tasks = {task["instance_id"]: task for task in registration["instances"]}
214	    started = 0
215	    for row in rows[len(state["rows"]):]:
216	        if max_trials is not None and started >= max_trials:
217	            return False
218	        payload = receiver_input(row, tasks[row["instance_id"]], secret)
219	        raw, status = invoke(command, payload)
220	        if status:
221	            raise RuntimeError(f"receiver adapter failed at {row['trial_id']}; retry same trial")
222	        state["rows"].append({"trial_id": row["trial_id"],
223	                              "receiver_input": payload,
224	                              "receiver_stdout": raw})
225	        checkpoint(progress, state)
226	        started += 1
227	    ledger = {"registration_sha256": seal["registration_sha256"],
228	              "sender_seal_sha256": seal_hash, "seal_commit": seal_commit,
229	              "receiver_command": command, "receiver_rows": state["rows"]}
230	    write(ledger_path, ledger, private=True)
231	    ledger_hash = digest(ledger_path.read_bytes()) + "\n"
232	    (run_dir / "ledger.sha256").write_text(ledger_hash, encoding="ascii")
233	    public_ledger.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
234	    if public_ledger.exists():
235	        raise FileExistsError(public_ledger)
236	    public_ledger.write_text(ledger_hash, encoding="ascii")
237	    return True
